strings: A thin layer of dust coating the floor.
Basic railing meant to protect idiots like you from falling.
A flexible, superconducting insulated cable for heavy-duty power transfer.
A one meter section of regular pipe.
Has a valve and pump attached to it.
Pull this in case of emergency. Thus, keep pulling it forever.
Different from the Middle Ages version.
You can be totally screwy with this.
A combined label printer, applicator, and remover, all in a single portable device. Designed to be easy to operate and use.
Come on Lady Luck, spawn me a pair of sunglasses.
A head-mounted face cover designed to protect the wearer completely from space-arc eye.
A small electronic device able to record a voice sample, and send a signal when that sample is repeated.
A standard edition welder provided by Nanotrasen.
A combined blastdoor and mass driver control unit.
Used to access the station's automated alert system.
Soft velvet carpeting. Feels good between your toes.
A catwalk for easier EVA maneuvering and cable placement.
You sit in this. Either by will or force.
It's a floor-mounted device for projecting holographic images.
A control terminal for the area's electrical systems.
This is used to lie in, sleep in or strap on.
A remote control switch for a mechanical curtain.
A machine that monitors atmosphere levels. Goes off if the area is dangerous.
It has some unsavory stains on it...
A luxurious double bed, for those too important for small dreams.
It is decorated with a crate emblem in silver lining.  It's rather tough, and just the thing to lie on after a hard day of pushing paper.
A type of plumbing constructor designed to harvest from geysers and collect their fluids.
A wrench with common uses. Can be found in your hand.
It's a storage unit for emergency breath masks and O2 tanks.
A large structural assembly made out of metal; It requires a layer of iron before it can be considered a wall.
A small screen which the AI can use to present itself.
A huge chunk of reinforced metal used to separate rooms.
Heavy duty mechanical shutters with an atmospheric seal that keeps them airtight once closed.
The output side of a turbine generator, contains the turbine and the stator.
Emergency air-tight shutter, capable of sealing off breached areas. This one has a glass panel. It has a mechanism to open it with just your hands.
A huge chunk of iron used to separate rooms.
It's a storage unit for standard-issue Nanotrasen attire.
A versatile chest rig, cherished by miners and hunters alike.
A robust satchel for stashing your loot.
A console intended to send requests to different departments on the station.
You shouldn't see this. Report it please.
A painting machine that can be used to paint PDAs and trim IDs. To use, simply insert the item and choose the desired preset.
A simple yet bulky storage device for gas tanks.

An ultra-futuristic, sleek, advanced, next-gen normal digital clock that tells the time. Powered by bluespace. Despite supposedly being better in every way to classic clocks, it just doesn't feel the same. They just don't make them the way they used to...
A Prism-brand path illumination device. It is anchored in place and glowing steadily.
A super-capacity superconducting magnetic energy storage (SMES) unit. Relatively rare, and typically installed in long-range outposts where minimal maintenance is expected.
A lightweight lift platform. It moves.
A lightbulb you can walk on without breaking it, amazing.
A square piece of iron standing on four metal legs. It can not move.
Crack it open, inhale the musk of its pages, and learn something new.
A full tile window that is reinforced with metal rods.
An underfloor disposal pipe with a sorting mechanism.
A wall-mounted first aid station, designed to treat minor injuries - just stick your hand in and try to relax.
All the finest of miscellaneous electronics one could ever need! Not responsible for any injuries caused by reckless misuse of parts.
It's an underfloor wiring terminal, used to draw power from the grid.
A standard Nanotrasen-licensed newsfeed handler for use in commercial space stations. All the news you absolutely have no use for, in one place!
A vending machine is guaranteed to spawn here, but its exact model is not known. The normal atlas view shows one possible outcome; the actual machine is chosen when the round starts.
A great place for storing knowledge.
A trusty station intercom, ready to spring into action even when the headsets go silent.
A white satin shirt with some bronze rank pins at the neck.
An updated, modular intercom that fits over the head. Takes encryption keys.
Can hold security gear like handcuffs and flashes.
Do not apply fire to this. Rumour says it burns easily.
Long-used as a symbol of rest, peace, and death.
Do jump on it, it can take it.
Now you see me, now you don't...
Used for scanning and alerting when someone enters a certain proximity.
Used to remotely activate devices. Allows for syncing when using a secure signaler on another.
What did I say about leaning on the glass tables? Now you need surgery.
A small crowbar. This handy tool is useful for lots of things, such as prying floor tiles or opening unpowered doors.
This can be used to check medical records.
Used to access the various cameras on the station.
In Greek myth, Prometheus stole fire from the Gods and gave it to 		humankind. The jewelry he kept for himself.
Used to monitor the station's atmospherics sensors.
For connecting portables devices related to atmospherics control.
A reinforced version of the four legged table.
A machine for dispensing clothing related to genetics.
A little bit of nature contained in a pot.
A lightweight support lattice. These hold our station together.
A one meter section of heat-exchanging pipe.
A heap of dense garbage. Perhaps there is something interesting inside?
A sign labelling the AI's heavily-fortified satellite.
A warning sign which reads 'SECURE AREA'.
A refrigerated storage unit for medicine storage.
A crafting bench fitted with tools, securing mechanisms, and a steady surface for blacksmithing.
From BlenderTech. Will It Blend? Let's test it out!
A shutter with a thick see-through polycarbonate window.
A window that is reinforced with metal rods.
Sturdy exterior hull plating that separates you from the uncaring vacuum of space.
You probably shouldn't be holding this.
\"In case of emergency, please use the stairs.\" Thus, always use the stairs.
A special pipe to bridge pipe layers with.
A standard issue colored jumpsuit. Variety is the spice of life!
Protects your hearing from loud noises, and quiet ones as well.
It's a storage unit for laser tag equipment.
A poster depicting TerraGov's logo and motto, reminding viewers of who's looking out for humankind.
This device recharges energy-dependent lifeforms, like cyborgs, ethereals, and MODsuit users.
For art pieces hung by the public.
A basic handheld radio that communicates with local telecommunication networks.
Fishing anywhere, anytime... anyway what was I talking about?
A fake, cheap looking, plastic tree. Perfect for people who kill every plant they touch.
A small wall mounted cabinet designed to hold a fire extinguisher.
A heavy duty blast door that opens mechanically.
Used to view and edit personnel's security records.
Extremely sturdy exterior hull plating that separates you from the uncaring vacuum of space.
Flooring that shows its contents underneath. Engineers love it!
A telescreen that connects to the engine's camera network.
A sign that warns of extremely cold air in the vicinity.
Heats or cools gas in connected pipes.
A charging dock for energy based weaponry, PDAs, and other devices.
Old will forever be in fashion.
Press the button for a deployment of slightly-unethical PARTY!
N.T. approved roulette wheel beacon, toss it down and you will have a complementary roulette wheel delivered to you.
All engineering related spawners go here
